text:
elaine_sales: quick sync — Zenith (POC) just sent their security questionnaire back. main open items: domain ownership for SSO, how SCIM provisioning will scope to multiple tenants, and RBAC mapping for our role model. can we run through options?
cto_zenith: thanks. priority for them is: 1) verify only company domains can self-signup, 2) SCIM should only provision users to a single tenant per idp mapping, 3) audit logs retention for provisioning events.
ashley_presales: noted. for domain ownership we usually support DNS TXT or email validation. for enterprise they want domain verification tied to provisioning so users with @zenith.co auto-claim.
mike_se: @ashley_presales for the POC I recommend DNS TXT verification — avoids forwarding rules. we also need to confirm if they require domain allowlist at the auth proxy vs. app-level check. which one does Redwood recommend for private deployments?
ashley_presales: for Private/VPC customers we can enforce at the auth proxy (control plane) and sync to the app — that gives stronger isolation. Hosted mode we do app-level allowlist + org claims from SAML assertion.
cto_zenith: on SCIM: they want to map SAML groups to Redwood orgs so provisioning only creates users in the right tenant. our legal/security team also wants a guaranteed delta-only sync (no full sync writes) for the first 30 days. is that doable?
infra_eng: we support incremental SCIM (incremental List/Change tokens) for Okta/AD mappings. for the POC we can flip on "delta-sync" which uses the SCIM "startIndex/operations" pattern and we log change-ids. however some IdPs don't surface change tokens consistently — we'll detect and fall back to paged listing.
security_bot: FYI — provisioning events are logged to audit.log (retention: 90 days default). can request extended retention (SLA add-on).
elaine_sales: pricing question from the customer — if we enable SCIM delta + domain verification + extended audit retention (1 year), what does that look like for POC vs GA?
ashley_presales: rough: POC (1 month, up to 500 MAUs) — no extra charge for feature flags, but audit retention add-on is +$2k/month. GA (annual) — SCIM + domain ownership included on Enterprise plan; extended retention billed per TB. I can pull exact quote.
mike_se: technical blocker: RBAC mapping — they want Azure AD group A => Redwood role "admin", group B => "editor" and group C => "viewer". need to confirm we support nested groups and custom role names.
infra_eng: we do group-to-role mapping, custom role names supported. nested groups: depends on IdP — we can evaluate at onboarding. for the POC we can implement a simple transform rule in our SCIM mapper.
cto_zenith: audit trail is big — they need proof that user X was provisioned by group mapping at time T, including SAML assertion id. can you capture assertion id in the audit event?
security_bot: yes — we include assertion_id and assertion_issuer fields in provisioning audit events for SAML flows. exported as CSV/JSON via the console.
elaine_sales: action items: 1) @mike_se to draft SCIM mapping example + sample SAML metadata for Zenith, 2) @ashley_presales to produce pricing delta for 1-month POC vs annual, 3) @infra_eng to confirm delta-sync fallbacks and audit retention options, 4) legal_ops to review questionnaire answers.
ashley_presales: I'll prepare a brief one-pager and a sample Okta mapping snippet. attaching sample:```json
{
  "group-to-role": [{"idp_group":"AAD:Zenith_Admins","redwood_role":"admin"},{"idp_group":"AAD:Zenith_Editors","redwood_role":"editor"}]
}
```

mike_se: sample SAML metadata snippet for their IdP we can ask them to paste into their config:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://identity.zenith.co">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://idp.zenith.co/sso"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

infra_eng: note for onboarding — if their IdP doesn't provide change tokens, we'll run full paged scans every 6h by default for the POC; for GA we can tune frequency. will document any drift events.
legal_ops: I'll review the sec questionnaire answers and flag anything on data residency and retention. expect comments by EOD.
cto_zenith: great. timeline: POC kickoff next Tue, would like SSO + SCIM working in first 3 business days. is that realistic?
mike_se: yes for POC baseline — SSO via SAML + DNS TXT domain verification + SCIM basic provisioning (non-delta) we can have in 72 hours. delta-sync depends on IdP.
elaine_sales: perfect. I'll coordinate calendar invites. cc @security_bot for audit retention ticket. :thumbsup:
